summary: Canonized direction-work-order (spine-and-tickets) into a DESIGN draft, three DTCG token layers, 12 Decisions, 8 Locks, validation with zero errors and two accepted warnings, and 7 recorded exceptions; all tournament carry-ins and repairable-defect fixes encoded, requesting advance.

claims.claim: DESIGN draft fills all 13 slots with token-name citations and no TBD values
Primitive layer carries only raw values (color/space/size/radius/typography/elevation/motion) with no purpose semantics
Semantic layer covers purpose tokens plus all 8 spacing roles; component layer references semantic tokens only, no raw primitive reaches any component
Spine-and-tickets thesis preserved without dilution: one spine per session, one node per assistant turn, active-ticket-only elevation, ruled rows never cards
All approved carry-ins encoded: C status rollup + keep-status/hide-duration + sticky-bottom composer below 820px; D cite-back stamping + attempt-keeping retry; B 44px targets + footnote translation
Repairable defects repaired in contract: 375px status persistence, 30+ turn spine compression rule, offline-safe numeral stack with no Impact-dependent voice
Status is never color-only and AA contrast pairs hold for all text/status pairs; reduced-motion static fallbacks specified for every animated state
Every Lock carries scope plus reopening conditions; every departing value is recorded in exceptions with its reason
Validation names all 8 checks with zero errors and two accepted warnings; 375-1440px collapse rules leave no horizontal scroll with composer persistently reachable

decisions.choice: Exactly one ticket per viewport carries elevation `lift.active`; all others are flat with 1px `border.rule`; tool rows are never cards; spine never elevated [applies to: agentic-model-chat center column, all widths]
rationale: Serves the Direction CARD-SOUP GUARD: depth means job state, so selection is unambiguous at any scroll position.
alternatives: Allow two elevations (active + hovered); allow emphasis shadows on failed tickets
risks: Implementation pressure re-adds card fills for emphasis; guarded by L-02.
revisitWhen: A usability pass shows users cannot find the selected ticket without a second cue; then add a non-shadow cue (numeral weight), never a second shadow.

decisions.choice: One continuous 2px `spine.rail` per session with one node per assistant turn chronologically; user turns are ticks not nodes; at 30+ turns completed runs collapse to counted groups while failures and current job stay addressable with jump-to-failure [applies to: spine navigator, all widths]
rationale: Serves the spine-and-tickets thesis: time-as-space navigation where resumption starts with where-was-I, not scrolling.
alternatives: Paginate turns; virtualize with unmounted history; second rail for session switching
risks: Scrollspy + compression complexity is the Run's highest build risk; accepted warning W-2 tracks it.
revisitWhen: Build proves 30-turn compression illegible in the strip variant; then revise the collapse count threshold, never the one-node-per-turn rule.

decisions.choice: Keep-status/hide-duration: at <=480px tool rows keep kind chip + mono target + chevron + status glyph, hide duration text and detail stat; ticket head keeps the status pill (rollup) and hides only the duration; spine labels keep the status word, hide counts/durations [applies to: ticket head, tool rows, spine labels at <=480px]
rationale: Repairs the tournament's top defect (A hides tool-row status labels <=480px) with C's proven pattern; status is state, duration is metadata.
alternatives: Hide whole tool rows at 375px (specimen defect); shrink status to color dots
risks: Cramped rows at 375px; mitigated by 84px kind column and two-line target wrap.
revisitWhen: A 375px render pass shows target truncation colliding with the status glyph; then wrap target to two lines before touching status.

decisions.choice: Composer is sticky-bottom below 820px (docked, full-width, above drawers); docked in-flow at desktop widths; echo docks to spine position within 300ms [applies to: composer, <=820px widths]
rationale: Carry-in from C plus C-T6/C-P3: steering stays reachable where drawers otherwise push it off; satisfies composer-persistently-reachable floor.
alternatives: Static composer that scrolls away; floating action button opening the composer
risks: Sticky stacking vs strip-spine z-order; resolved by explicit z scale (strip < drawers < composer).
revisitWhen: Viewport-height testing shows the sticky composer covering drawer actions on short screens; then compress composer chrome, never unstick it.

decisions.choice: Every well and the evidence wing header carry a cite-back stamp: Turn NN / Kind target + status + duration; wing header mirrors the selected ticket and re-stamps on selection change [applies to: wells, evidence wing header]
rationale: Carry-in from D: evidence never detaches from the turn that cites it; implements per-session scoping as a visible contract.
alternatives: Generic attachment titles (Browser / Files); citation only in ticket wells
risks: Long targets overflow the stamp; mitigated by anywhere-wrap plus two-line clamp.
revisitWhen: A further surface reuses the wing for cross-session content; then the stamp gains a session token, never drops the turn token.

decisions.choice: Attempt-keeping retry language: retry reads Retry failed <Kind> step (T0N); failure renders in place with exit/code/line evidence; red spine node persists until retried or dismissed with a recorded reason; no toasts, no auto-dismiss, live-region announcement [applies to: failed tickets, error boxes, spine failure nodes]
rationale: Carry-in from D plus trust-but-verify product truth: the operator stays accountable, so history of attempts is never rewritten.
alternatives: Generic Retry button; auto-dismiss failures after re-run; toast on failure
risks: Label length at 375px; mitigated by wrapping action rows.
revisitWhen: Retry taxonomy grows (partial re-run, skip-step); then extend the label grammar, never shorten to bare Retry.

decisions.choice: 44px minimum touch target for every interactive control: tool rows, chevrons, tabs, mode toggles, follow-ups, buttons including small variants, spine nodes (26px visual + 44px hit area in strip mode) [applies to: all interactive controls, all widths]
rationale: Carry-in from B plus C-A4: density is rhythmic compression of information, never compression of targets.
alternatives: Keep specimen 40px chevrons and small buttons; 36px dense rows
risks: Vertical density cost (~4px per small control); accepted, recorded in EX-04.
revisitWhen: Platform guidance changes the floor; then move all targets together via target.min, never per-component.

decisions.choice: Margin-to-footnote translation: at <=820px right-wing meta (density proof, static-mock disclaimers, capture notes) re-renders as labelled footnotes below the ticket stack, never dropped [applies to: evidence wing meta, <=820px]
rationale: Carry-in from B: narrow widths translate chrome, they do not delete it; audit context survives the strip.
alternatives: Drop wing meta at narrow widths; truncate density proof
risks: Page length growth at 375px; bounded by single-disclosure fallback.
revisitWhen: Footnote volume exceeds ticket volume on short sessions; then collapse footnotes behind one disclosure, never delete.

decisions.choice: Numerals use the grotesk stack with font-stretch condensed + 800 weight + tight tracking; fallback chain is system-only (Arial Narrow, HelveticaNeue-CondensedBold, Franklin Gothic Condensed, DIN Condensed, system-ui); Impact is excluded from the voice chain [applies to: turn numerals, spine labels]
rationale: Repairs the numeral fallback hazard and honors C-P2 offline boot: the ordering voice cannot depend on a face missing on Linux or blocked offline.
alternatives: Keep specimen Impact/Haettenschweiler condensed stack; ship a CDN condensed face
risks: Numerals render wider on systems lacking all condensed faces; contained by fluid 38-52px clamp.
revisitWhen: Offline-bundled condensed face is approved for the Run; then prepend it to font.numeral, never a CDN reference.

decisions.choice: Neutral kind chips: white ground, graphite border, ink mono text for all tool kinds; saturated color reserved strictly for status and diff [applies to: tool rows, file-tree change markers excepted]
rationale: Serves rationed-signal color thesis and critic should-fix: hue always means status or diff, so the rail survives grayscale and kind never masquerades as state.
alternatives: Keep specimen per-kind tinted chips (blue/purple/amber/green grounds)
risks: Weaker kind scannability for color-reliant users; mitigated by fixed mono kind abbreviations.
revisitWhen: Kind taxonomy exceeds 8 and scanning suffers; then add shape (prefix glyph) coding, never hue coding.

decisions.choice: Turn-header status rollup: ticket head always shows numeral + role + status pill + duration; pill glyph + word mirror the worst tool-row state (failed > running > succeeded > no-tools) [applies to: ticket head, all widths]
rationale: Carry-in from C: glanceability without opening the ticket; the rollup is what makes keep-status/hide-duration coherent at 375px.
alternatives: Status lives only in tool rows; ticket head shows numeral + duration only
risks: None material; pill space reserved in head grid at all widths.
revisitWhen: Mixed-state tickets (partial failure) need finer rollup; then add counts to the pill label, never remove the pill.

decisions.choice: Motion narrates the rail lifecycle only: queued-enter, amber running pulse (opacity steps), settle-to-terminal, composer echo-to-dock, scrub cross-highlight; staged stub progress is honestly labelled synthetic pacing; all motion has a static reduced-motion equivalent; prose streams caret-only, shimmer banned [applies to: running tickets, spine nodes, composer echo, scrub]
rationale: Serves progress-along-rail motion role within C-A4 and the fake-determinism risk: waits stay legible without implying measurement.
alternatives: Determinate bars from measured progress; shimmer streaming prose; pulse everywhere
risks: Stub honesty labels add ticket copy; accepted as trust cost.
revisitWhen: Real streaming transport arrives; then staged labels retire to measured states, never to shimmer.

risks: Spine scrollspy plus 30-turn compression is the highest build cost and is specified but unproven in render; build must prove strip-spine scrub and collapse counts with a 30-turn fixture (confidence: medium).
Staged stub-duration progress risks reading as fake determinism if honesty labels are dropped in implementation; labels are locked copy, not decoration (confidence: medium).
Two-turn sessions may feel over-mechanized; empty-trace and near-chat degradation rules cover it but need a short-session render check at build (confidence: low).
Narrow-viewport rail collision at 375px is contained by the strip + drawer + sticky-composer rules but still needs a live 375px pass to confirm no overlap (confidence: medium).
